items: Bucket of Water or a pair of ice gloves or smiths gloves(i)
rec: Ardougne Cloak to teleport to monastery
enemies: Able to survive a hit or 2 from an Ogre (level 53)

st.t: Talk to Brother Kojo in the Clock Tower to start the quest.
Enter the Clock Tower basement for the red cog.
Go through the south east door and pick up the red cog.
Climb back up the ladder and use the red cog on the red spindle, on the column beside the ladder on the ground floor.

Get the bucket next to Brother Cedric, north of the monastery, and fill it at the well next to it for the black cog. Skip this if you already have a bucket of water, or will wear ice gloves or smiths gloves (i) for the black cog.
Climb down the ladder to the east of the Clock Tower, next to Brother Cedric.
Follow the tunnel and push the wall at the end.
Pick up the blue cog.
Climb up the ladder, go into the Clock Tower and climb the stairs to the first floor. Use the blue cog on the blue spindle there.

i: There's a bucket and a well and just next to brother cedric for the black cog

st.t: Enter the Clock Tower basement for the black cog.

Go through the north-east door and as far east as you can, to the fire. Use your bucket of water on the black cog, then pick it up. If you are wearing ice gloves or smiths gloves (i), just pick it up.
i: Bucket of Water or a pair of ice gloves or smiths gloves(i)

st.t: Go back to the ladder you came down, but don't climb it. Use the black cog on the black spindle, one of the four spindles beside the ladder.

i: Bucket of Water or a pair of ice gloves or smiths gloves(i)

st.t: Enter the Clock Tower basement for the white cog.
Pick up the rat poison in the north west of the dungeon.
Go north-east along the passage to the rat cage. There are two levers on its north wall. Pull the west lever up. If the gates to the food trough stay shut, pull the east lever up too.
Use the rat poison on the food trough. Wait till the rats have died.
Go through the gate.
Pick up the white cog.
Climb the ladder next to the white cog, go into the Clock Tower and climb the stairs to the top floor. Use the white cog on the white spindle there.
Talk to Brother Kojo in the Clock Tower for your reward.
